question: Which of the following is a function of the Smooth Endoplasmic Reticulum (SER)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Manufacture of lipids**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Smooth Endoplasmic Reticulum (SER)** is primarily responsible for the **manufacture of lipids**. Lipids are essential for cell membrane formation, energy storage, and signaling.
 
• Unlike the Rough Endoplasmic Reticulum (RER), the SER lacks ribosomes, which gives it a smooth appearance under the microscope.
 
• The SER is involved in the **synthesis of steroid hormones** in endocrine cells, such as those in the adrenal glands and gonads.
 
• It also plays a crucial role in the **detoxification of drugs and harmful substances** in liver cells.
